post.description:
Enriches a transaction with information about entities, locations and categories. Besides the original `id` that was
submitted, the response only contains the enriched fields. 

To view the complete transaction, including the original fields, such
as description or amount, you can use any of the Transactions API listing methods.

Complete guide: [Transaction Enrichment](../../../enrichment/introduction).

get.description: Return a list of enriched transactions starting with the most recent one.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only return transactions older or equal than this date

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Only return transactions newer than this date

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Starting point for the set of transactions

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The limit of transactions to be returned

parameters.name: account_holder_id
parameters.description: If specified, only return the transactions of this account holder

404.description: Transaction with the provided id not found.

delete.description: Deleting a transaction will also delete it from our systems. This operation is permanent.

404.description: Transaction with the provided id not found.

post.summary: Assign a transaction to an account holder
post.description: Changes the account holder associated with the transaction. The old and new account holder must share the same `type`.

404.description: Transaction or account holder with the provided id not found.

post.description:
Creates a batch of requests and runs them asynchronously. Each element of `data` has to be compatible with the body
expected by the `operation`. A batch representing the progress and the status of the process is returned as a result.
You can retrieve the results using [/v3/batches/:id/results](./get-batch-results) once the batch has finished
processing.

This endpoints supports up to 24960 requests.

Complete guide: [Batches](../../../batches).

get.description: Returns a list of submitted batches starting with the most recent one.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only return batches older or equal than this date

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Only return batches newer than this date

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Starting point for the set of batches

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The limit of batches to be returned

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: If specified, only return batches with this status

404.description: Batch with the provided id not found.

get.summary: Retrieve the results of a batch
get.description:
Returns batch metadata along with a list containing the body of the responses of each request in the batch. The 
responses are returned in the same order they were submitted. The schema of each response body is given by the 
respective `operation` of the batch.

Results are available after the batch has finished processing.

200.description: Returned batch of transaction enrichment results.

404.description: Batch with the provided id not found.

post.summary: Quickly extract account holder, institution and first account
post.description:
Extracts account holder, bank and account information extracted from the first page of the bank statement, which is typically available before the full results. This is a synchronous call.

Complete guide: [Fast verification](../../../fast-verification)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the entity

404.description: Entity does not exist for ID

post.description:
Resolves a query into an entity by querying our entity resolution system.
The parameters `name` and `website` are mutually exclusive. Calls to this endpoint using
the `name` parameter are billed the same way transactions are.

post.summary: Find recurring groups in a transaction history
post.description:
Identifies and categorizes recurring patterns found in the transaction history of the account holder,
such as periodic payments or subscriptions. These patterns are called recurrence groups. 

Complete guide: [Recurrence](../../../enrichment/recurrence).

404.description: Account holder with the provided id not found.

post.summary: Set a custom set of categories
post.description: Sets a custom set of categories. Transactions that don't match a category will be categorized `not enough information` regardless of whether it is present in the set.

get.description: Retrieves the set of categories. Category sets are different per account holder type.

200.description: Category set for the selected type of account holder

post.summary: Reset category set to original values
post.description: Resets the set of categories of the specified account holder type to the original values.
